headline: Mid-America Apartment Q2 FFO Misses Estimates as Same-Store NOI Falls
summary: MAA lags Q2 FFO estimates as same-store NOI declines, but improving lease trends and a steady development pipeline point to stabilizing operations.

headline: Mid America Apartment Communities (MAA) Stock Looks Below Fair Value With Cash Flow But Above Fair Value On Earnings
summary: Mid-America Apartment Communities stock sits at a crossroads, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to meaningful upside while traditional market multiples indicate the shares are not cheap, all against a five year price decline of about 12.9%. headline: Evercore ISI Group Maintains In-Line on Mid-America Apartment, Lowers Price Target to $130
summary: Evercore ISI Group  analyst Steve Sakwa   maintains Mid-America Apartment (NYSE:MAA) with a In-Line and lowers the price target from $132 to $130.
